text:
Alex M: quick sync — we need a small, shipable status surface for GA that covers chat, embeddings, rerank, and function calling. goal: consistent client behavior + clear retry guidance.
Priya R: +1. customers keep asking for deterministic retry hints and a single structured body for errors.
Jason L: major asks from sales: reserved capacity should surface a distinct code (so SDKs can surface billing/reservation UX). also want model-unavailable vs capacity-downgrade separation.
Emily T: proposal: MVP codes = 429 (rate_limit), 422 (validation), 503 (model_unavailable), 409 (capacity_conflict/reserved), 424 (downstream_failed), 500 (internal). include retry_after and a machine-readable error_class.
Marco G: sounds reasonable. do we expose both numeric status and a stable string code? e.g., 503 + "model_unavailable"? SDKs need stable strings for logic.
Alex M: yes — both. structured error body example (MVP):
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "model_unavailable",
    "http_status": 503,
    "message": "primary model unavailable; falling back to smaller model",
    "error_class": "availability",
    "retry_after": 30,
    "extensions": {"route_id": "chat-v2", "model_variant": "gpt-*-quant"}
  }
}
```
Priya R: keep extensions flat strings for now. no nested objects in extensions for GA. customers want parseable fields.
Jason L: question on function-calling errors — should invalid function schema be 422 or a new 400x family? some clients need to differentiate user prompt validation vs function wiring failures.
Emily T: prefer 422 for schema/validation. add error_class: "function_schema" or "input_validation". that covers SDK routing.
Marco G: what about streaming interruptions? do we return an HTTP error mid-stream or a terminal event in the stream payload?
Alex M: spec: streaming will emit an error frame with the same structured body and then close the stream. non-stream clients get a normal HTTP error. document mapping in SDKs.
infra-bot: deploy note: feature-flag gating available in staging. use flag error-surface-v1 for testing.
Priya R: launch criteria checklist (draft): 1) spec doc + examples; 2) SDK mappings for js/python; 3) e2e tests for fallback behavior; 4) telemetry + error-class tags in logs; 5) migration notes for partners; 6) policy for adding new stable codes.
Jason L: prioritization: MVP (must-have) = codes above + retry_after + string codes + streaming error frames + SDK mapping. Nice-to-have = per-model shaping, rate-limit buckets per-tenant, auto-adjusted retry hints.
Emily T: timeline ask: can we aim to ship MVP in next sprint if eng takes only the surface + SDK wiring? otherwise push to next.
Marco G: resource note: eng-ml needs a small runtime change to return error_class; eng-platform to add header X-Redwood-Error-Class.
Alex M: scope negotiation: we will not do model-specific error messaging for GA. instead include extension.model_variant so consumers can implement heuristics.
Priya R: docs: include client examples demonstrating retry strategy: exponential backoff + honoring retry_after when present; recommend max total retries for 429/503 = 3.
Jason L: can we add a short JSON-LD-ish schema in the spec for validators? helps partner integrations.
Alex M: ok add a lightweight schema snippet. keep it permissive.
Marco G: final note: logging plan — surface error_class + route_id + model_variant in telemetry. product needs dashboards for top 10 error_classes by endpoint.
Priya R: I will write the spec PR with examples and a checklist. tagging @Jason L and @Emily T for SDK acceptance criteria.
Alex M: thanks. next: Priya to post PR link and milestone target. :thumbsup:
